faq.q1: How does the AI matching work?
faq.a1: Our AI engine analyzes your support request, identifies the required SAP module expertise, and matches you with consultants based on their skills, ratings, availability, language preferences, and hourly rates.
faq.a2: Yes, every consultant goes through a rigorous verification process including SAP certification validation, AI-based skills assessment, reference checks, and identity verification.
faq.a3: We cover 20+ SAP modules including S/4HANA, ECC, BTP, SuccessFactors, Ariba, Fiori, Basis, Security/GRC, ABAP, and all functional modules (FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM, PS, EWM, TM).
faq.a4: Yes, the platform offers full Arabic RTL support, Arabic-speaking consultants, and localized content for the GCC market.
faq.a5: We offer session-based billing, hourly rates, and fixed-price packages. Time is tracked automatically, VAT-ready invoices are generated, and payments are processed securely through multiple gateways.
